failure.noReset: Reset time not provided by the provider.
failure.noWindows: The provider did not return usage windows or a reset time.
failure.refreshFailed: Could not retrieve current usage. Check your account connection and try again. The provider has not confirmed a reset time.
failure.sessionBusy: This native session is active elsewhere. Finish or close the other Codex session, then send your saved draft again.
failure.reconnect: Reconnect your native agent account to continue.
failure.couldNotFinish: The agent could not finish this turn.
failure.usageUnavailable: Current usage could not be retrieved. The provider has not confirmed a reset time.
failure.notRecorded: Usage and reset time were not recorded for this failure.
failure.staleUsage: Could not refresh usage. The snapshot above was checked at the displayed time.

declined.label: Declined by you
declined.guidance: The action was not authorized. Change the request or explicitly approve a new attempt.

permissions.label: Blocked by permissions
permissions.guidance: Review conversation access and the provider’s saved rules. Access was not expanded automatically.

authentication.label: Authentication required
authentication.guidance: Reconnect the affected account or server in Connections before trying again.

disconnected.label: Server disconnected
disconnected.guidance: Check the server in Connections and reconnect it. The action was not automatically repeated.

unavailable.label: Tool unavailable
unavailable.guidance: Refresh the server’s tool list in Connections and check whether this tool is supported.

timeout.label: Response timed out
timeout.guidance: The remote outcome is unconfirmed. Check its state before repeating an action that changes data.

outcome.turn-completed: Turn finished; no response to this request was confirmed
outcome.turn-failed: Turn failed before this request was answered
outcome.interrupted: Turn interrupted before this request was answered
outcome.connection-lost: Connection closed; response not confirmed. This saved request cannot be answered.

live.waitingUpdate: Waiting for the next agent update
live.backgroundReported: Background work reported by the provider
live.label: Current agent activity
live.waitingConfirmed: Waiting for a confirmed provider update
live.slowTitle: This step is taking much longer than the same step took earlier in this conversation
live.turnTitle: Total time for this turn, including previous commands and waiting for input
live.waitingInputFull: Provider is waiting for input. Open Diagnostics to inspect the request.
live.reportsState: Provider reports {{state}}. Local output still needs reconciliation.
live.notConfirmed: Execution outcome is not confirmed. Your message was not resent.
